alerts.evidence: CloudTrail event was performed by the AWS root identity.
alerts.mitre_attack: T1078 Valid Accounts - Initial Access / Privilege Escalation
alerts.recommendation: Avoid root account activity. Use named IAM roles/users with MFA and least privilege.
Review source IP, user, and failure volume. Enforce MFA and investigate repeated failures.
Require MFA for console access and review whether this identity is exempt from MFA controls.

alerts.evidence: CreateAccessKey was called for an IAM principal.
alerts.recommendation: Confirm the key is approved. Rotate or delete unexpected access keys immediately.

alerts.rule_name: IAM policy attachment or policy change
alerts.mitre_attack: T1098 Account Manipulation - Privilege Escalation / Persistence
alerts.recommendation: Review the policy diff, target principal, and change ticket. Revert unauthorized privilege changes.

alerts.rule_name: Security group opened to the world
alerts.evidence: Ingress rule includes public CIDR range(s): 0.0.0.0/0.
alerts.mitre_attack: T1562 Impair Defenses / Initial Access support
alerts.recommendation: Restrict inbound access to trusted CIDRs and confirm the exposed port is required.

alerts.evidence: StopLogging can reduce AWS audit visibility.
alerts.recommendation: Re-enable logging, protect CloudTrail with least privilege, and investigate the actor immediately.

alerts.mitre_attack: T1078 Valid Accounts / T1098 Account Manipulation
alerts.recommendation: Validate the source IP, role target, session name, and business reason for the role assumption.

alerts.evidence: CreateUser created or attempted to create IAM user new-backup-user.
alerts.mitre_attack: T1136.003 Create Account: Cloud Account - Persistence
alerts.recommendation: Confirm the user was approved. Prefer federated identities and remove unexpected IAM users.

alerts.evidence: DeactivateMFADevice changed MFA protection for an identity.
alerts.mitre_attack: T1556.006 Modify Authentication Process: Multi-Factor Authentication
alerts.recommendation: Confirm the MFA removal was approved. Re-enable MFA and review recent activity for the identity.

alerts.rule_name: S3 bucket policy changed to public-risky permissions
alerts.evidence: PutBucketPolicy made public-style access possible on bucket sample-public-risk-bucket.
alerts.mitre_attack: T1619 Cloud Storage Object Discovery - Discovery / Exfiltration risk
alerts.recommendation: Remove public principals, enable S3 Block Public Access, and review object access logs.

alerts.evidence: 3 denied API calls from actor probe-user at 203.0.113.88: DescribeInstances, ListBuckets, ListUsers.
alerts.mitre_attack: T1087 Account Discovery / T1110 Brute Force - Discovery or Credential Access
alerts.recommendation: Review whether the actor is probing permissions, using stale credentials, or attempting unauthorized access.
